name: Toumayhem
source:
Yuki Kourei enrolls into Shigo Private High School, between the mountains of Hokkaido, to start life anew far from his hyper-protective mother.

His plan goes awry when he discovers the school's rigid hierarchies, in which the younger students must follow all of their upperclassmen's orders; too nervous to join them, he's completely cut off from the others and branded as Ghost.

Akito Ikeda, a fellow Ghost, persuades him to join the Spectral Brigade: a group of first-years who want to overthrow the current system. But nightmares and visions of someone dying haunt Yuki, and when a snowstorm cuts him and his schoolmates off from the outside world, these visions come true.

Yuki will have to win the trust of his schoolmates, discover who's trying to kill them, and why...

[From [url=https://crescendo.itch.io/toumayhem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yuki Kourei就读于北海道山区之间的私立志乡高中，远离他过度保护的母亲，开始新的生活。

当他发现学校严格的等级制度时，他的计划出了差错，低年级的学生必须遵守所有高年级学生的命令；由于太紧张而无法加入他们，他与其他人完全隔绝，并被贴上幽灵的标签。

池田明人，一名幽灵同伴，说服他加入幽灵旅：一群想要推翻现行制度的一年级学生。但噩梦和有人死去的幻象一直困扰着由纪，当一场暴风雪将他和他的同学与外界隔绝时，这些幻象成真了。

由希必须赢得同学的信任，找出谁试图杀死他们，以及为什么……

[来自[url=https://crescendo.itch.io/toumayhem]Itch.io[/url]]
